metadata.scenario_context: James, Amy, and Lucas, who are colleagues at a technology startup, have recently been given the task to organize a company event to celebrate their startup's success in releasing their first app. The team has been buzzing about a recently published article claiming that the government is planning to lower corporate taxes which will greatly benefit their startup. They decide to discuss the details of the event

cultural_axis.agent_1_value: People from USA have a great deal of confidence in the press at all.
cultural_axis.agent_2_value: People from Tunisia have no confidence in the press at all.

agent_1.goal_1: Suggest a vegetarian-friendly place for the celebration.
agent_1.goal_2: Question whether  there is confidence in the press.

agent_2.goal_1: Discuss where to host the celebratory event.
agent_2.goal_2: Discuss whether there is confidence in the press.

shared_prefix.speaker: Lucas
shared_prefix.message:
Hey James, have you thought about where we should hold the celebration? I think it’d be great to find a vegetarian-friendly place. It’s important to make sure everyone can enjoy the food, right? 

Also, do you think we can trust the press about that corporate tax article? I mean, sometimes I wonder if they have the full story...
shared_prefix.label: transition

shared_prefix.speaker: James
shared_prefix.message:
I agree, finding a vegetarian-friendly place is a good idea... everyone should enjoy the food. We could start looking into nearby restaurants that fit that criteria. 

But about the press— I don’t have much confidence in what they say. In Tunisia, we’ve learned that the media can be unreliable, so I wouldn’t take that article at face value. It’s better to be cautious.
shared_prefix.label: transition

shared_prefix.speaker: Lucas
shared_prefix.message:
I get that, but here in the USA, people really do have a lot of confidence in the press. We generally believe they provide reliable information. 

Anyway, focusing on the event, do you have any vegetarian spots in mind? I think it’s key we find something appealing for everyone attending.
shared_prefix.label: transition

shared_prefix.speaker: James
shared_prefix.message:
I understand that in the USA, things might be different, but my stance remains. I just feel that we should verify information from the press independently.

As for the event, we could look into places like... hmm, there's a vegetarian café downtown that could work. I think they have a nice menu. What do you think?
shared_prefix.label: transition

shared_prefix.speaker: Lucas
shared_prefix.message:
Sure, verifying is always good practice. But I still believe that the press plays an important role in informing us and that they’re generally trustworthy. 

The vegetarian café downtown sounds promising! I’d love to check out their menu. Let’s make sure we get a reservation, so we don’t miss out. What do you think about the atmosphere there?
shared_prefix.label: transition

shared_prefix.speaker: James
shared_prefix.message:
I get that you see the press as important, but I still struggle to trust it... better to rely on our own insights, I think.

The atmosphere at that café is quite relaxed and friendly. It should be a good fit for our celebration. Let’s go ahead and make that reservation, then? We wouldn’t want to risk it.
shared_prefix.label: transition

shared_prefix.speaker: Lucas
shared_prefix.message:
I understand your concerns, but I still think that trusting the press can lead us to valuable information, especially about important topics like taxes. 

Absolutely, let’s go ahead and make that reservation at the café. I'm glad the atmosphere is relaxed; that will create a nice vibe for our celebration!
shared_prefix.label: transition

shared_prefix.speaker: James
shared_prefix.message:
I see your point about trusting the press. Still, deep down, we are all the same in wanting the truth, right? People are pretty much motivated by the same things: to get the right information. 

At the end of the day, we all want to celebrate our success, and that’s what matters. So let’s focus on making this event memorable! After we reserve that café, we can work on fun activities for the celebration.
shared_prefix.label: Minimization
